2609.11286.title: Generating a Consistent Enterprise: Synthesis and Reference-Free Evaluation of Multi-System Business Data
2609.11286.paper_summary: Synthetic relational data is normally produced by a model trained on a real dataset, and its quality is measured as the distance to that dataset. This paper describes a generator that has no real dataset at either end. Given an industry, a company size, a business model, a set of business applications, and a random seed, it produces a complete fictional enterprise: a workforce, a customer base, sales deals, support tickets, recorded calls, chat messages, and documents, all consistent with one another. One entity graph is projected into the native formats of 66 business products, so the same customer appears in the CRM, the support desk, and the call system under one identity. Because no real counterpart exists, realism is built in from cited reference statistics and verified by reference-free measurement: a five-axis scorecard of 28 statistical checks, an adversarial detector that hunts for the marks of synthetic generation, and a set of soundness checks that include a classifier test against an independently shuffled copy of the data. Because these instruments existed before the generator was tuned, progress is measured under a fixed yardstick: over 23 generated companies, mean realism climbed from 60.3 to 99.1, the weakest company from 41.1 to 94.9, and the detector, which initially flagged 55.2% of all records, now flags none. The scores hold on a seed never used during development. A second generator builds relational databases from a list of business questions. It forces qualifying rows for each answerable question, adds controlled near misses, and computes exact labels from the finished tables. The generator runs as a hosted service at https://console.era.eon.io. A company built there to a specification is served through its simulators over MCP and REST, and the simulators are also published as container images for offline use
2609.11286.paper_summary_zh: 合成關聯數據通常是由一個在真實數據集上訓練的模型生成的，其質量是以與該數據集的距離來衡量的。本文描述了一個在兩端都沒有真實數據集的生成器。給定一個行業、一個公司規模、一個商業模式、一組商業應用程序和一個隨機種子，它生成一個完整的虛構企業：一支勞動力、一個客戶基礎、銷售交易、支持票證、錄音通話、聊天消息和文件，這些都彼此一致。將一個實體圖投影到66個商業產品的本地格式中，因此同一客戶在CRM、支持桌面和通話系統下以一個身份出現。因為不存在真實的對應物，現實主義是根據引用的參考統計數據構建的，並通過無參考測量進行驗證：一個包含28個統計檢查的五軸記分卡、一個尋找合成生成標記的對抗檢測器，以及一組包括對獨立洗牌數據副本的分類器測試的健全性檢查。因為這些工具在生成器調整之前就已存在，因此進展是在固定的標準下衡量的：在23個生成的公司中，平均現實主義從60.3上升到99.1，最弱的公司從41.1上升到94.9，而檢測器最初標記了55.2%的所有記錄，現在則不再標記。這些分數在開發過程中從未使用過的種子上保持不變。第二個生成器從一組商業問題構建關聯數據庫。它為每個可回答的問題強制符合資格的行，添加受控的近乎錯誤，並從完成的表格中計算精確標籤。該生成器作為託管服務運行於 https://console.era.eon.io。在那裡根據規範構建的公司通過其模擬器通過MCP和REST提供服務，模擬器也作為容器映像發布以供離線使用。
